integrity: Integral Alexander duality for the link, punctures and infinity, the relative cohomology exact sequence, explicit global Gauss classes, and integral Leray-Hirsch prove the product uniformly. The proof does not extrapolate from finite computations. The full text of the close 1989 work was compared at its general theorems and knot-complement example.
scientific_limitations: Only additive integral cohomology of ordered configurations in complements of smooth links in R^3 is computed; no cohomology-ring, unordered-configuration, or moving-link total-space assertion. The unknot/trefoil distinction uses the fundamental group.
title: Link-blind integral Betti polynomials of ordered point configurations
